2607.25570.title: The LAIA Dataset: Labelled Attention for Intelligent Automobiles
2607.25570.paper_summary: The development of autonomous vehicles (AVs) usually relies heavily on data-driven artificial intelligence (AI) models that require large volumes of sensor data with ground-truth annotations. While modular architectures are widely used, end-to-end driving paradigms offer a promising alternative by directly mapping sensor inputs to control actions. However, their adoption is limited by challenges in interpretability and explainability. To address this, we present LAIA (Labelled Attention for Intelligent Automobiles), a novel synthetic dataset designed to enrich end-to-end driving research with human attention data. Collected using the CARLA simulator in closed-loop environments, LAIA comprises over 15 hours of driving from 44 participants across carefully crafted scenarios designed to evoke natural responses. Each sequence includes RGB images under six weather conditions, semantic and instance segmentation, depth, optical flow, CAN bus signals, and synchronized eye-tracking data. LAIA enables applications including training attention-aware end-to-end AI drivers, predicting driver behavior, developing methods to detect anomalous driver-attention patterns, and improving model explainability. In this work, we use LAIA to compare human attention with the perceptual attention emerging in our end-to-end driving models, thereby providing insight into their behavior.
2607.25570.paper_summary_zh: 自主車輛（AVs）的發展通常依賴於需要大量帶有真實標註的傳感器數據的數據驅動人工智能（AI）模型。<lb/>雖然模組化架構被廣泛使用，但端到端駕駛範式通過直接將傳感器輸入映射到控制行動，提供了一個有前景的替代方案。<lb/>然而，它們的採用受到可解釋性和可解釋性挑戰的限制。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了LAIA（標註注意力智能汽車），這是一個新穎的合成數據集，旨在通過人類注意力數據來豐富端到端駕駛研究。<lb/>LAIA是使用CARLA模擬器在閉環環境中收集的，包含來自44名參與者在精心設計的場景中駕駛超過15小時的數據，這些場景旨在引發自然反應。<lb/>每個序列包括在六種天氣條件下的RGB圖像、語義和實例分割、深度、光流、CAN總線信號以及同步的眼動追蹤數據。<lb/>LAIA支持的應用包括訓練注意力感知的端到端AI駕駛員、預測駕駛員行為、開發檢測異常駕駛員注意力模式的方法，以及提高模型的可解釋性。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們使用LAIA來比較人類注意力與我們的端到端駕駛模型中出現的感知注意力，從而提供對其行為的洞察。
